pcs.pc_description: check and ensure materials are available (i.e. precious metal strips or wires, solder powder, pliers, tweezers, cutters etc.,) as per the requirement of the jewellery pieces
ensure that the precious metal strips or wires are annealed, cleaned and dried before assembly
match the strips or wires to the sketch drawn on the paper and cut it to a desired length
bend and twist the strips or wires with the help pliers, tweezers and fingers to make outer frame and various design components
dip the assembled frame in borax, water mixture, sprinkle solder powder and solder frame assembly with torch flame
pickle and clean frame with sulphuric acid, water and gentle rubbing with brass brush
assemble various design components inside the frame as per sketch and follow same procedure of soldering and cleaning
check soldered joints, compare the design, shape and flow with the original sketch at intermediate steps and after complete soldering
maintain proper records of metal received and returned prior and post assembly
ensure that the target is achieved as per order
